_meta.note: Breadth batch, 16 new brands (working down HSS score order). Every URL below was fetched with curl -sL (normal browser user-agent, redirects followed), returned HTTP 200 at the final URL, and the page text was grepped for the claim recorded in `supports`. The final URL after redirects is what is stored. Company self-reporting is labelled source_type=company_report and is_primary=1. Brands with only one solid source were left short rather than padded: no URL in this file was guessed or pattern-built, and blocked domains were not worked around with plausible substitutes.
_meta.lead_review: Dropped plantaform and smol (homepage-only evidence, not substantive reporting) on 2026-10-30. All remaining URLs re-checked by the lead: HTTP 200 and claim present.

attitude.title: Attitude — About us
attitude.supports: Attitude states that its vision is to redefine what 'clean' means by proving performance, transparency and sustainability 'can — and must — go hand in hand', and highlights EWG Verified formulas.

attitude.title: Attitude — EWG Verified
attitude.supports: Attitude maintains a dedicated EWG Verified page describing the Environmental Working Group certification its products carry, which screens formulations for ingredients of health and environmental concern.

dropps.title: Carbon Neutral Shipping and Climate Action: How Dropps Reduces Its Carbon Footprint
dropps.supports: Dropps' February 2022 post explains what carbon neutrality means in practice for its shipping, naming the partners involved and how it measures and offsets shipment emissions.

dropps.title: Dropps tests limits of a lean, clean supply chain
dropps.supports: Dropps reports using Convoy to manage its full truckload freight network around a shared vision of supply-chain sustainability, describing how it manages inbound logistics.

dropps.title: Dropps — B Corp certification announcement
dropps.supports: Dropps announces its B Corporation certification on its own site, framing it around the assessment of the company's social and environmental performance.

ecos.title: Our Impact on the Environment — ECOS
ecos.supports: ECOS' Our Impact page states that it makes affordable green cleaning products and fights for policies that reduce climate and pollution impacts on underserved communities.

ecos.title: Journey to a Climate Positive Clean — ECOS sustainability
ecos.supports: ECOS' sustainability page sets out its 'Journey to a Climate Positive Clean', stating that it is intentional in every step of the business from ingredient sourcing onward.

ecos.title: Zero Waste Certification: What Does It Mean? — ECOS
ecos.supports: ECOS states that it achieved TRUE Platinum Zero Waste certification and explains what the standard requires of a manufacturer.

frontier-co-op.title: About Frontier Co-op
frontier-co-op.supports: Frontier Co-op describes itself as a member-owned co-op that is 'responsible to people and planet', operating since 1976.

frontier-co-op.title: Regenerative Organic Certified — Frontier Co-op
frontier-co-op.supports: Frontier Co-op maintains a dedicated Regenerative Organic Certified page listing the ROC-certified products in its range.

traditional-medicinals.title: Supporting Biodiversity and Communities: Traditional Medicinals' Commitment to FairWild Certification
traditional-medicinals.supports: Traditional Medicinals explains its commitment to FairWild certification for wild-collected herbs, tying it to environmental and biodiversity protection and to collector communities.

traditional-medicinals.title: The Certification You May Not Know About: Fair for Life
traditional-medicinals.supports: Traditional Medicinals describes the Fair for Life certification and the farmers, wild collectors and processors behind its tea supply chain.

traditional-medicinals.title: Protect the Planet — Traditional Medicinals
traditional-medicinals.supports: Traditional Medicinals' sustainability article states it is taking responsibility to preserve Earth's ecosystems and acknowledges that everything it does has an impact.

upcircle-beauty.title: 2023 Corporate Social Responsibility Report — UpCircle Beauty
upcircle-beauty.supports: UpCircle publishes a corporate social responsibility report (April 2024) setting out its social and environmental commitments for the 2023 year.

upcircle-beauty.title: We are now a certified B Corporation! — UpCircle Beauty
upcircle-beauty.supports: UpCircle announces it is now a certified B Corporation and describes itself as a circular brand.

upcircle-beauty.title: Circular Beauty Impact: UpCircle's Ingredient-Rescue Numbers
upcircle-beauty.supports: UpCircle publishes the ingredient-rescue numbers behind its circular beauty model, quantifying the by-products it diverts into skincare.

abeego.title: The First B Corp Certified Beeswax Wrap in Canada — Abeego
abeego.supports: Abeego states that it achieved B Corp certification, describing it as the only certification measuring a company's entire social and environmental performance.

abeego.title: Circular Manufacturing: The Progression of an Idea — Abeego
abeego.supports: Abeego describes setting out to build a zero-waste, circular manufacturing company, citing its mission, values and B Corp certification as the drivers behind product design.

cleancult.title: Sustainability — Cleancult
cleancult.supports: Cleancult's sustainability page states that it has joined rePurpose Global and holds Plastic Neutral Certification, funding waste-management projects that recover plastic.

biokleen.title: About Biokleen
biokleen.supports: Biokleen's About page sets out the brand's plant-based cleaning product positioning and its environmental claims.

maple-hill.title: Signed, Sealed, Certified — Maple Hill
maple-hill.supports: Maple Hill states that it is Certified Organic and a partner in Organic Plus Trust, listing the certifications behind its low-intervention dairy.

maple-hill.title: Sustainable vs. Regenerative Agriculture — Maple Hill
maple-hill.supports: Maple Hill explains the difference between sustainable and regenerative agriculture and where its own dairy farms sit on that spectrum.

georganics.title: About us — Georganics
georganics.supports: Georganics' About page sets out the brand's plastic-free oral care approach and its environmental positioning.

triarchy.title: Responsibility — Triarchy
triarchy.supports: Triarchy's Responsibility page describes its water-saving and ozone-based denim finishing and its recycling approach in production.

imperfect-foods.title: Impact — Imperfect Foods
imperfect-foods.supports: Imperfect Foods' Impact page sets out its food-waste and carbon impact, framing the business around rescuing imperfect produce.

imperfect-foods.title: Resources and Reports — Imperfect Foods
imperfect-foods.supports: Imperfect Foods publishes a resources and reports page holding its impact reporting and related disclosures.

pact-organic.title: Fair Trade Certified factories and clothing — Pact
pact-organic.supports: Pact explains what Fair Trade Certified factories are and why it sources its organic cotton clothing from them.
